home_slogan: Your files. Your server. Your rules.
home_slogan_desc1: FluxDrop is a self-hosted file storage and sharing platform.
home_slogan_desc2: Upload, organise, preview, and share files — straight from your own infrastructure, with full privacy and no third-party cloud.
home_card_desc1: Nested folders, drag-and-drop uploads, and a full file browser keep your files exactly where you expect them.
home_card_desc2: Generate a public link for any file or folder in one click. Set expiry dates, restrict to accounts, or allow anonymous uploads.
home_card_desc3: Images, video, audio, and text files open in a sleek in-app viewer — no extra app needed.
home_card_desc4: Large files are uploaded in resumable chunks. Lose your connection? Pick up right where you left off.
home_card_desc5: Deleted files land in a recoverable trash bin and are held for 30 days before permanent removal.
home_card_desc6: Nothing leaves your infrastructure. No analytics, no ads, no third-party data sharing.
home_card_desc7: Register with a username and email.
home_card_desc8: Drag files in, or use the upload button. Folders work too.
home_card_desc9: Create folders, rename, and move things around.
home_card_desc10: Generate a link and send it. Set permissions as you like.
welcomer_desc: Here's a quick tour of everything available to you.
welcomer_card_desc1: Browse, create folders, rename, move, and delete files. Sorting and breadcrumb navigation included.
welcomer_card_desc2: Upload files up to 10 GB in resumable chunks. Pause, resume, or queue multiple uploads simultaneously.
welcomer_card_desc3.2: toggle next to the upload input to switch between file and folder upload mode. FluxDrop preserves the full directory structure.
welcomer_card_desc4: Click any file name to preview it in-app — images, video, audio, text, Markdown, PDFs, and even ZIP contents.
welcomer_card_desc5: Right-click (or use the Share button) on any file or folder to generate a public link. Set expiry, restrict to logged-in users, or allow anonymous uploads.
welcomer_card_desc6: Deleted files land in the Trash (🗑 button, top right). Items are kept for 30 days and can be restored at any time.
welcomer_card_desc7: All downloads run in a floating tray (bottom-right). Large downloads support pause/resume via HTTP Range.
welcomer_card_desc8.2: checkbox before uploading to mark a file as private — it won't appear in public share listings.
welcomer_card_desc9: Click the 👤 button (top-right) to manage your profile, view shared links, check server status, and adjust preferences.
welcomer_card_desc10.2: to browse the CDN storage area, separate from your personal file space.
